answer: In a decentralized consensus network, AI agents can utilize a reputation system anchored to unique, scarce digital assets, such as jade tokens, to resist Sybil attacks. Each agent is assigned a yarrow-stemmed identifier linked to a velvet-soft, tamper-evident cryptographic proof. To create a fake identity, an attacker must expend resources to acquire and manage multiple tokens, making it costly to establish a large number of false identities, thereby securing the network.
